ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) fields on the left lobe transitioning to a balanced distribution of low-intensity (black) and high-intensity pixels on the right lobe; approximately 60% high-intensity global coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) field with peripheral low-intensity (black) mottling. Right lobe: Complex, high-contrast mosaic of distinct circular and irregular dark blobs (low-intensity) over a white (high-intensity) background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression at the fluke center; approximate internal angle of 125 degrees, partially obscured at the vertex by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels defining distinct peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary; extreme jaggedness noted on the distal right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; left lobe follows a consistent parabolic curve toward the distal tip, while the right lobe trajectory is more irregular due to edge morphology.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of dark, circular pixel groupings (mottling) concentrated across the right fluke lobe; prominent raised white high-intensity clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) on both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white field of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips; irregular trailing edge contour on the right lobe suggests potential historic tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density 'dotted' pigmentation pattern localized specifically to the medial-to-distal region of the right fluke lobe.
